actualNative.description: Dark irregular mixed-size brown/grey/olive stone masonry; smaller staggered blocks surround two large central stones.
actualNative.landmarkLimits: Visual source region estimates, not a registration transform or approved future relief mask. Actual source outlines and stepped joint phase decide fidelity.
actualNative.surfaceMarks: Pale diagonal marks on broad faces are interpreted as restrained mineral tone/weathering, not deep V carvings or wood grain.
actualNative.edgeIntent: Preserve original cropped stones/stepped mortar contacts; no invented small edge bricks, frame, top/bottom strip or image-perimeter bevel.

material.chosen: Roughly dressed weathered dark brown sandstone ashlar with narrow dark recessed mortar.
material.historicalUncertainty: Stone species/dressing history is an artistic interpretation of Low, not geological proof.
material.recognitionCues: Coherent mineral faces, restrained pores/cemented grains, subtle dressed facets and small weathered edge chips; no uniform synthetic grain or exaggerated pillow faces.
material.palette: Subdued dark brown, grey-brown and olive-grey; low value and native local colour distribution.
material.usageLimit: 1274unique-content face records; mostly vertical1049, but other orientations exist. Not area weighted, visibility/PVS or camera exposure.
